description: Create a page in a space you can edit, owned by you. `space` is the space key; `parentId` puts it under another page in that space; `content` is the body in markdown. Only call when the person asked for this page.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

parentId.description: Optional: the id of the page to put it under.

name: anyforge_create_page
title: Create page
